title: Off topic some, but did anyone here see Tarantino in the 1998 Wait Until Dark revival?

commenti.body: Yes! My wife and Insaw it on Broadway, as we live right across the river in northern NJ. Unfortunately Marisa Tomei was off that night so an understudy filled in but that was fine. I vividly remember the scene where the blind female protagonist turned off all the  lights and doused QT in…kerosene, maybe, so he couldn’t light a match. At that point the theater was so dark you couldn’t see your hand in front of your face (I checked). Then a crack of light appeared onstage as Q…slowly and silently…opened the refrigerator door-the only source of light the protagonist (and the audience) had forgotten about. Quentin was poised right next to the open fridge door and he had the most ghoulish, evil smile I’ve ever seen!
Damn I can picture that look of his. Was his acting any good generally?

Hmmm it’s been so long. He was the same “Quentin” character he usually plays, but the creepy version similar to his character in From Dusk Till Dawn. This was very early in his career and I was super gassed to see him perform live. His acting is…like most non actors who act…kind of one note, but it was very cool seeing him in that play on broadway.
